paper.title_en: Primordial black hole contribution to the stochastic background of gravitational waves
paper.abstract_en: The amplitude of the detected stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) measured by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and the discovery of early and over-massive central black holes at high redshift by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) challenge current models of supermassive black hole (SMBH) formation. We aim to study if halos containing a significant population of primordial black holes (PBHs) would increase the amplitude of the PTA signal. PBHs add an iso-curvature component to the matter power spectrum, accelerating the formation and merger of dark-matter halos at all redshifts. We propose that black holes in the halo sink to the center via dynamical friction. The central black hole grows through hierarchical merging in addition to the gas-accretion channel. We computed the resulting GW amplitude and performed a Bayesian inference analysis using the NANOGrav 15-year dataset. We show that the predicted amplitude of the gravitational-wave background agrees with the observations. Our model only requires $0.09\%-0.12\%$ of the total mass of the halo to fall to the center; this is compatible with a fraction of $f_{\rm pbh}\sim 0.1$ PBHs being dark matter if the in-falling PBHs in the stellar mass range represent about $1\%$ of the total population, as was found in our previous estimation of the formation of SMBHs at $z\sim 6-10$. The PBH model that explains the JWST new found populations of SMBHs also explain the amplitude of the stochastic background of gravitational waves.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文通过提出PBHs对SGWB振幅的贡献，直接回应了PTA观测与JWST发现的冲突，提供了新的理论解释和贝叶斯分析，对PTA领域具有高度相关性。
decision.title_zh: 原初黑洞对随机引力波背景的贡献
decision.abstract_zh: 由脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）测得的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的振幅，以及詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）在高红移处发现的早期且超大质量的中心黑洞，对当前超大质量黑洞（SMBH）形成模型提出了挑战。我们旨在研究包含大量原初黑洞（PBHs）的暗物质晕是否会增加PTA信号的振幅。PBHs向物质功率谱增加了一个等曲率分量，加速了所有红移处暗物质晕的形成和合并。我们提出，晕中的黑洞通过动力学摩擦下沉到中心。中心黑洞通过层级合并以及气体吸积通道增长。我们计算了由此产生的引力波振幅，并使用NANOGrav 15年数据集进行了贝叶斯推断分析。我们表明，预测的引力波背景振幅与观测结果一致。我们的模型仅要求晕总质量的0.09%-0.12%落到中心；这与如果下落的恒星质量范围PBHs约占总体的1%（如我们之前在红移z~6-10处形成的SMBHs的估计中所发现的那样），则暗物质中PBHs的比例f_pbh~0.1是兼容的。解释JWST新发现的SMBH群体的PBH模型也解释了随机引力波背景的振幅。
